input.rationale: The Agreement contains no MFN obligation running against us. The only MFN-type pricing covenant (§ 7.6) runs in our favour: "Vendor warrants that Fees charged to Customer will be no less favourable than fees offered to any similarly situated customer for comparable volumes and terms" — a Vendor-granted best-pricing warranty, which the playbook welcomes and does not redline. Section 12.3 goes further and expressly confirms that "Customer has made no ... most-favoured-customer ... commitment," and I found no right-to-match, offer-disclosure, or best-terms-to-Vendor mechanic in the Fees (§ 7), Order Form (§ 4), or General (§ 30) provisions. This meets the preferred position (no Customer MFN obligation benefiting Vendor), so no change is proposed.
